**Adam Sewall**: Founder and Board Member at Waterleaf International for 9 months with 35 years 7 months of total professional experience. Previous roles include Board Member at Tradeworx, President and CEO at T3Communications, and SVP Business Development and Operations at fastmobile. Based in Fort Myers, Florida, United States [US].

---

A Major Inflection Point in Cyber + AI Security

We’re starting to see press coverage around a development that represents a fundamental shift in the threat landscape—but I wanted to offer a bit more detail than what has circulated publicly.

For the first time, we now have a documented case of agentic AI autonomously obtaining access to confirmed high-value intelligence targets—including major technology companies and government agencies.
While many of us expected these capabilities to evolve, what stands out is how quickly they have done so, and at scale.

The link below provides deeper context on the TTPs involved. It’s highly relevant for anyone thinking about how to build defensive measures that can keep pace with this new class of threats. More to come on this soon.
One immediate takeaway: I’m recommending the use of custom and specific classifiers embedded within LLMs to help mitigate this emerging category of AI-driven intrusion techniques.
